title: A supply census before each plan names why the wave has fewer todos than slots, and proposes splits of mixed items
summary: In the 12 cycles 1908-1920, triage committed top_n = 1 every time. A wave of fleet.count lanes can then run only as many lanes as the wave seed finds, which was 1-2.
fix: Plan components O6 (D4) and O2c (D5a), spec section 4. The census classifies each ranked inbox item (admissible, waiting_cell, waiting_deps, console_route, console_kind, console_protected), records the counts in the run record, and publishes LOOP_ORCH_SUPPLY_SHORT. Below twice the window, it writes a split proposal for each mixed item, and the console accepts it with `evolve inbox split <id>`. The census never routes an item. Design: docs/plans/wave-orchestrator-2026-10.md and docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md (ADR-0139).
acceptance: `TestSupply_RecordsTheCauseOfEachRefusal` passes, and the inbox files do not change.
